note: Read by .github/scripts/risk_gate.py (risk-tier workflow, report only) and by the controller, which sets risk:T0..T3 from it. The tier is the highest of every changed path (and a rename's old path), content hits in added lines of code files, and the size cap. Merge policy per tier: AGENTS.md › Merge policy. Editing this file is itself T3.

T3.meaning: high risk (core loop, adapters, installers, release, CI, process): a PASS at the tip (self-PASS counts) and Danyang's explicit merge click; never auto-merged, never admin-merged

T2.meaning: medium risk (package code, bench, tools, site config, and any path no rule names): a PASS at the tip (self-PASS counts) and Danyang's explicit merge click

T1.meaning: low risk (tests, examples, changelog fragments, site assets, generated API page): auto-merge on green CI after a self-review PASS at the tip

T0.meaning: lowest risk (documentation): auto-merge on green CI after a self-review PASS at the tip
